questions.stem: 全組一起完成的報告，通常比一個人包辦的報告更有創意。
questions.answer: Reports finished by the whole group are usually more creative than those done by a single person.
accepted_answers: Reports completed by the whole team are usually more creative than reports done by just one person.
A report finished by all the group members is usually more creative than one done by a single member.

questions.stem: 完成幾次分組報告後，學生們也越來越懂得與組員溝通合作。
questions.answer: After finishing several group projects, students also become better and better at communicating and cooperating with their group members.
accepted_answers: After completing a few group reports, students also get better and better at communicating and working with group members.
After doing several group projects, students also grow better and better at communicating and cooperating with other members.

1.explanation_zh: 「全組一起完成的報告」是被完成的，用過去分詞片語放在名詞後面：reports finished by the whole group。「比一個人包辦的報告更有創意」用比較級 more creative than，比較對象要對等，用 those done by a single person 代替 reports done by …。creative 是多音節形容詞，比較級寫 more creative。
evidence: 比一個人包辦的報告更有創意
1.strategy_zh: 「被…的＋名詞」先寫名詞，再接 p.p. 片語；寫比較句前先確認兩邊比的是同一類東西。
hints: 切成四段：全組一起完成的報告／通常／比一個人包辦的報告／更有創意
標的詞彙：report（報告，L1）、group（組，L1）、finish（完成，L1）、usually（通常，L1）、single（單一的，L2）、creative（有創意的，L3）
句型框架：N + p.p. + by … + be + more + adj. + than + those + p.p. + by …

2.explanation_zh: 「完成…後」和主要子句主詞相同，用 After + V-ing：After finishing several group projects。「越來越懂得與組員溝通合作」用「比較級 and 比較級」：become better and better at communicating and cooperating with their group members；at 是介系詞，後面兩個動詞都用 V-ing，保持平行。
2.strategy_zh: 「越來越＋形容詞」用「比較級 and 比較級」；good 的比較級是 better，不要寫 more better。
hints: 切成四段：完成幾次分組報告後／學生們也越來越懂得／與組員／溝通合作
標的詞彙：finish（完成，L1）、project（專題報告，L2）、communicate（溝通，L3）、cooperate（合作，L4）、member（組員，L1）
句型框架：After + V-ing …, S + also become + better and better at + V-ing and V-ing + with …

references: Reports finished by the whole group are usually more creative than those done by a single person.
Reports completed by the whole team are usually more creative than reports done by just one person.
A report finished by all the group members is usually more creative than one done by a single member.

比較級（以 those／one 代替前面的名詞）

patterns.zh_trigger: 比一個人包辦的報告更有創意

Reports completed by the whole team

common_errors.wrong: The whole group together finished reports
common_errors.right: Reports finished by the whole group
common_errors.explanation_zh: 「全組一起完成的報告」修飾語很長，英文要把分詞片語放在名詞後面（後位修飾）。

common_errors.wrong: Reports finishing by the whole group
common_errors.right: Reports finished by the whole group
common_errors.explanation_zh: 報告是「被」完成的，用過去分詞 finished，不是現在分詞。

accepted: usually
often
generally
tend to be

common_errors.explanation_zh: 修飾形容詞要用副詞 usually。

accepted: than those done by a single person
than reports done by just one person
than one done by a single member
than those done by only one person
than those done by one person alone
than those completed by one person

common_errors.right: than those done by a single person
common_errors.explanation_zh: 比較的對象要對等：報告要和報告比，不能拿報告和「一個人」比；用 those 代替 reports。

common_errors.wrong: than that done by a single person
common_errors.right: than those done by a single person
common_errors.explanation_zh: 代替複數的 reports 要用 those；單數才用 that 或 one。

accepted: more creative
more original
show more creativity

common_errors.explanation_zh: be 動詞後面要用形容詞 creative，creativity 是名詞（名詞↔形容詞）。
多音節形容詞的比較級用 more + 原級。

traps.literal_error: The whole group together finished reports are usually more creative than one person do all the reports.
traps.explanation_zh: 中文的長前置修飾要改成後位的分詞片語 reports finished by the whole group。

traps.literal_error: Reports finished by the whole group usually have more creative than those done by a single person.
traps.explanation_zh: 「有創意」是形容詞 creative；用 have 就要接名詞 creativity，詞性要配合動詞。

1.restructuring_zh: 兩個「…的報告」都是前置修飾，英文改成後位的過去分詞片語：reports finished by the whole group、those done by a single person；第二個 reports 用 those 代替，避免重複。

references: After finishing several group projects, students also become better and better at communicating and cooperating with their group members.
After completing a few group reports, students also get better and better at communicating and working with group members.
After doing several group projects, students also grow better and better at communicating and cooperating with other members.

common_errors.explanation_zh: and 連接的兩個動詞要同樣形式（平行結構），都放在介系詞 at 後面，用 V-ing。
介系詞 at 後面要接動名詞。

traps.literal_error: students also become more and more better at communicating and cooperating with their group members
traps.explanation_zh: better 本身就是比較級，再加 more 是重複。

traps.literal_error: After finish several group projects, students also become better and better at communicating.
traps.explanation_zh: 介系詞 after 後面接動名詞 finishing。

bonus.text: The more group projects students finish, the better they become at communicating and cooperating with others.
bonus.explanation_zh: 用「the + 比較級…, the + 比較級…」（愈…愈…）把做報告的次數和溝通合作的能力連在一起，是更進階的寫法。

1.translation: Reports completed by the whole group together are usually more creative than those done by one person alone.
1.explanation_zh: 「全組一起完成的報告」用過去分詞片語後位修飾 completed by the whole group；「比……更有創意」用比較級 more creative than；比較對象用 those 代替 reports，後接 done by one person alone 譯「一個人包辦」。

2.translation: After completing several group reports, the students have also become better and better at communicating and cooperating with their group members.
2.explanation_zh: 「完成幾次……後」用 After + V-ing；「越來越懂得」用 become better and better at + V-ing（也可 increasingly know how to）；時態用現在完成式表變化至今。「越來越」的寫法很多，故信心 medium。

issues_zh: （不影響判定）我的寫法 Reports completed by the whole group together 比 accepted 多了 together（對應「一起」），屬同義小差異。
（不影響判定）第 2 部分 accepted 只有現在式 students also become/get/grow better and better at；我用現在完成式 the students have also become better and better at（表示到現在的變化），同樣正確，建議補進 accepted。

1.translation: Reports completed by the whole group together are usually more creative than those done by one person alone.
1.explanation_zh: 「全組一起完成的報告」用過去分詞後置修飾 reports completed by ...；「比……更有創意」用比較級 more creative than；用 those 避免重複 reports。

2.translation: After finishing several group reports, students also get better and better at communicating and cooperating with their group members.
2.explanation_zh: 「完成幾次分組報告後」用 After + 動名詞；「越來越懂得」用 better and better at + 動名詞；『也』用 also。『越來越懂得』時態可用現在簡單式或現在完成式，所以信心 medium。
